final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. It is owned by security@harborlight.example and valid until 2027-11-17. Access Control Policy section 4.3 (Leavers) backs it up: access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day. No live setting check covers offboarding, so this is the documented commitment and has not been checked against actual practice.
